summary: 2026 H1 consolidated revenue was KRW 15.04tn and operating income KRW 2.00tn, up about 27.5% and 44.1% YoY on restated comparatives.
source: Hanwha Aerospace H1 2026 Half-Year Report, DART 2026-08-14, consolidated income statement / segment notes
analyst_note: Growth is real but consolidated figures include Hanwha Ocean and Hanwha Systems NCI.

summary: Disclosed order backlog is roughly KRW 115tn across aviation, defense, Hanwha Systems defense/IT, marine and space-related items; defense alone is about KRW 38.3tn.
source: Hanwha Aerospace H1 2026 Half-Year Report, detailed order-status table pp.492-493
analyst_note: Some defense/space contracts are omitted for security/confidentiality, so this is not a complete backlog.

summary: The filing describes entrenched European rearmament, persistent Middle East conflict and Indo-Pacific tension, with procurement emphasizing rapid force build-up, supply-chain resilience and local/co-production.
source: Hanwha Aerospace H1 2026 Half-Year Report, industry discussion around pp.41-42

summary: K9 and K239 Chunmoo have multi-country export records, and disclosed backlog includes Poland, Australia, Romania, Norway, Finland and India-related programs.
source: Hanwha Aerospace H1 2026 Half-Year Report, defense competitive advantages and order table

summary: 2026 H1 consolidated operating cash flow was approximately KRW -0.37tn despite operating income of approximately KRW 2.00tn.
source: Hanwha Aerospace H1 2026 Half-Year Report, consolidated cash flow statement p.68
analyst_note: Project working-capital timing can be volatile, but the gap requires monitoring.

summary: Contract assets rose from about KRW 6.49tn to KRW 7.07tn while contract liabilities fell from about KRW 15.99tn to KRW 15.04tn during H1 2026.
source: Hanwha Aerospace H1 2026 Half-Year Report, notes on contract assets/liabilities
analyst_note: This weakens near-term cash conversion even if revenue and margin remain strong.

summary: 2025 third-party placement and rights/general offering raised about KRW 4.22tn and materially increased the share count.
source: Hanwha Aerospace H1 2026 Half-Year Report, capital and use-of-proceeds sections pp.329-330
analyst_note: One-time strategic financing is not yet evidence of persistent dilution, but per-share returns must recover.

summary: As of 2026-06-30, only a minority of 2025 equity proceeds had been deployed; unused funds were held in high-quality bank deposits/financial products.
source: Hanwha Aerospace H1 2026 Half-Year Report, use-of-proceeds section pp.329-330
analyst_note: This preserves liquidity but means ROIC from the raise remains largely untested.

summary: Hanwha Aerospace reported domestic CP A1, unsecured bond AA and S&P A- corporate ratings as of H1 2026.
source: Hanwha Aerospace H1 2026 Half-Year Report, credit-rating section pp.5-6

summary: At 2026-06-30 consolidated cash and cash equivalents were about KRW 8.05tn while current and non-current borrowings/bonds totaled about KRW 15.4tn.
source: Hanwha Aerospace H1 2026 Half-Year Report, consolidated balance sheet
analyst_note: Liquidity is high, but expansion is capital intensive.

summary: Marine represented about 64% of H1 consolidated revenue and about 57% of segment operating profit before consolidation adjustments.
source: Hanwha Aerospace H1 2026 Half-Year Report, segment table pp.3-4
analyst_note: Consolidated growth can therefore be heavily influenced by the shipbuilding cycle.

summary: A major accident at the Daejeon site caused five fatalities and two injuries, triggering partial production suspension and company-wide safety inspections.
source: KRX/DART production suspension and major-accident disclosures, 2026-06-02 to 2026-06-04
analyst_note: This is a material operational-control signal, not merely an ESG label.

summary: The approximately KRW 454.8bn Vertical Aerospace VX4 EMA/tilting/blade-pitch development and supply contract was mutually terminated early after changes in market environment and project direction.
source: Hanwha Aerospace DART single sales/supply contract termination disclosure, 2026-08-03
analyst_note: This is not core K9/Chunmoo evidence but is relevant to new-business execution.

summary: Hanwha Aerospace disclosed an execution/derivative contract with Indra Sistemas for K9-related exports to Spain.
source: Hanwha Aerospace DART single sales/supply contract disclosure, 2026-08-31
analyst_note: Contract amount was not disclosed, so strength is capped.

summary: Post H1, Hanwha Aerospace's direct KAI stake rose to 9.90%; together with Hanwha Systems and Hanwha Aerospace USA the group stake reached 15.89%.
source: Public ownership disclosures reported Aug/Sep 2026; post-period event
analyst_note: Potential strategic synergy exists, but additional capital allocation and governance objectives require clarification.

summary: At KRW 1,055,000, a central SOTP using current listed-stake values, a 20% holding-company discount and normalized core EBIT assumptions gives a Base value near KRW 1.05m.
source: Analyst calculation using 2026-09-04 KRX market prices and H1 filing ownership data
analyst_note: SOTP is sensitive to NCI, stake discounts, net-debt classification and KAI post-period purchases.

summary: Scenario SOTP suggests roughly KRW 0.50m Bear, KRW 1.05m Base and KRW 1.59m Bull versus KRW 1.055m current price, so current downside/upside asymmetry is not especially favorable.
analyst_note: Probabilities and multiples are subjective estimates.
